payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the dataset collection process, including the number of questions, the categorization method, and the annotation process.

claims.text: The dataset consists of 7,787 science exam questions that were annotated by two annotators, with the lead annotator having professional domain expertise.
Questions were randomly shuffled during the annotation process to counterbalance learning effects, while being presented in grade order to reduce context switching.
The dataset includes detailed classification labels from a fine-grained hierarchical taxonomy of 406 problem domains.
